Description - GET /MusicFile.aspx

The string http://music.<domain>/MusicFile.aspx?chomik_id={chomikid}&sess_id={sessid}&seed={seed}&id=%1&ext=.%2 is only a playlist/cache identifier written to cache.cfg for ChomikBox 1.x compatibility; the {…} placeholders are never substituted and the client never requests it. Live probe: music.chomikuj.pl:80 timed out; the path on chomikuj.pl redirects to /Error404.aspx.

Parameters

Session id ({sessid}, never substituted).

seedqueryoptionalstring

Seed ({seed}, never substituted).

idqueryoptionalstring

File id (%1).

extqueryoptionalstring

Extension with a leading dot (.%2).

MusicFile.aspx?chomik_id=&sess_id=<token>&seed=&id=<fileId>&ext=.txt. The 2.0.8.2 client never requests this template (it is only a 1.x cache identifier; streams use the player.audio url). music.chomikuj.pl:80 timed out on connect, so the path is requested on chomikuj.pl. Observed: 302 to Error404.aspx.
